app.name: RuralMinds
app.tagline: Answers from your textbook, on the school Wi-Fi
lang.label: Language
login.title: Sign in
login.help: Your teacher gives you a username and password.
login.admin_note: Admins sign in on the school computer itself.
auth.throttled: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.admin_local_only: Admin sign-in works only on the school computer.
auth.forbidden: This page is not for your account.
error.offline: Can't reach the school computer. Check that you are on the school Wi-Fi.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.busy: Many students are asking right now. Please try again in a minute.
error.model: The answering program is not responding. Please tell your teacher.
error.paused: Answering is paused by the school for now.
error.language_off: Answers in this language are switched off right now. Try the other language.
error.class_off: Asking is switched off for your class right now.
error.invalid: Some details are missing or not right.
student.ask_placeholder: Type your question about this book…
student.no_books: No books are open for your class yet. Please ask your teacher.
student.empty_body: Every answer comes from your book and shows the page, so you can check it yourself.
step.checking: Checking the answer against your book…
label.ai_explanation: AI explanation — from your textbook, may contain mistakes
refusal.not_found: I couldn't find this in your textbook. Try choosing a different chapter, or ask your teacher. I've saved this question for your teacher.
refusal.time_sensitive: This changes over time, so your textbook can't give the current answer. Please ask your teacher. I've saved this question for your teacher.
page.title: Page {page}
teacher.title: Teacher
teacher.delete_confirm: Delete “{title}”? Students will lose it and its approved answers. This cannot be undone.
teacher.no_books: No books yet. Upload one to begin.
teacher.job.ingesting: Reading the pages… (Malayalam books take several minutes)
upload.limit: PDF only, up to {mb} MB and {pages} pages.
upload.title: Book title
upload.subject: Subject
upload.page_offset: Printed page number minus PDF page number
upload.page_offset_help: 0 if page 1 of the PDF is printed as page 1. Used so citations show the printed page.
upload.chapters_help: Chapter number, title, and the PDF page where it starts. {found}
upload.bookmarks_found: We filled these in from the PDF's bookmarks — please check them.
upload.submit: Save and start reading the book
upload.queued: Saved. The book is being read; you'll find it under Books when it is ready to check.
upload.not_pdf: This is not a PDF file.
upload.corrupt: This PDF is damaged or incomplete. If the power went off during the upload, upload it again.
upload.too_many_pages: This PDF has too many pages.
upload.duplicate: This exact book is already uploaded.
upload.disk_full: The school computer is almost out of space. Ask the admin.
upload.wrong_state: This upload cannot be changed now. Refresh the page.
upload.interrupted: The upload did not finish (power cut or lost Wi-Fi). Please upload again.
upload.chapter_page_range: A chapter start page is outside the PDF.
upload.chapter_order: Chapter start pages must go up, with no repeats.
upload.chapter_numbers: Two chapters have the same number.
upload.unknown_class: One of the classes no longer exists. Refresh the page.
try.approved: Approved: students asking exactly this get it instantly.
unanswered.empty: Nothing here. Questions the textbook could not answer will appear here.
unanswered.reason.admits_missing: Answer said the book lacks it
unanswered.reason.time_sensitive: Asks who holds an office now
approved.empty: No approved answers yet. Approve good answers in “Try the AI”.
activity.intro: Questions from your classes in the last {days} days, by chapter. Groups with fewer than {min} questions are hidden so no single student can be identified.
admin.title: Admin
admin.restart_confirm: Restart the AI servers? Answers stop for about a minute.
classes.not_empty: Move or delete the students in this class first.
accounts.created: Accounts created. Print the slips now — passwords are shown only once.
accounts.limit: The account limit is reached. Raise it in Settings.
accounts.bad_username: Use lowercase letters, numbers, - . or _ (2–32 characters).
accounts.privacy: Accounts hold only a username and class: no names, phone numbers or ID numbers. Questions are never linked to an account.
settings.model_note: The AI model is fixed for this server so answers stay tested and predictable. Changing it needs a new evaluation run.
admin.restart_failed: The AI servers did not restart. See logs/restart.log on this computer.
admin.restart_windows_only: Restart from here works on Windows only; use the start script.

answer.not_from_book: Not from your book — only to help you picture it.

settings.app_language_help: Language of the buttons and menus.
settings.answer_language_help: Auto answers in the language you type in. Manglish gets a Malayalam answer.
settings.privacy_body: Your questions are never linked to your name or account, and this chat is cleared when you sign out.
auth.expired: You were signed out after some time without use. Please sign in again.
try.note: Test how the AI answers, including books not yet published. Your tests do not go to the inbox.
